name: U.S. Against the World: Four Years with the Men's National Soccer Team
original_name: U.S. Against the World: Four Years with the Men's National Soccer Team
overview: A look inside the United States Men’s National Soccer Team in the leadup to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America in June. Filmed over the course of four years, the series follows Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Tim Weah, Weston McKennie, and an array of U.S. players on their personal and collective journeys toward their sport’s biggest stage.
